source_verification.verified: Independently opened and read the primary PDF's A1 overall reading comprehension and reading correspondence descriptors. They support working phrase by phrase with familiar words in very short simple texts, with rereading, and understanding short personal messages. Familiar everyday actions and directly stated facts in this batch fit that authoring direction.
